_readme: Edge functions that were deleted from this repository and must therefore also be deleted from
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. `supabase functions deploy` only ever pushes what is in supabase/functions;
it has no notion of a function that used to be there. Deleting the directory in a PR therefore
leaves the function ACTIVE on production, still routable, still holding whatever secrets it was
deployed with -- and check-edge-function-drift.mjs then fails the deploy with
`ORPHAN (remote not local)`. That failure lands AFTER `supabase db push`, so the migrations are
already applied: a half-applied deploy with a live function calling objects the migration just
dropped. prune-removed-edge-functions.mjs closes that by deleting each slug listed here through
the Management API before the presence check runs.
AN ENTRY IS A RECORD, NOT A DEBT. Unlike the allowlists in this directory, entries here are not
meant to be worked off. Once the slug is gone from production the DELETE returns 404 and the
script treats that as success, so the entry stays true forever and documents what was removed
and by which migration. Leave it.
SAFETY. A slug listed here must NOT exist under supabase/functions. If it does, the manifest and
the tree disagree about whether the function is live, and the script fails rather than guessing --
so a mistyped or stale entry cannot delete a function that is still deployed on purpose.

screen-exclusions.reason: Federal exclusion screening (OIG LEIE + SAM) was removed from the product in full: the tables, the on-hire trigger, the cron jobs, the console page and this function. Nothing calls it and the schema it read no longer exists.
